title: Space before of the first paragraph of a nextPage section: the excess over the previous paragraph's space after is kept at the page top (before=480 after prev after=200 -> +14, after=0 -> +24, after=600 -> flush), the same in compat 12 and 15
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-08, compat 15; compat 12 identical), pymupdf span tops, Letter, Calibri 11 docDefaults after=200 line=240, 14pt headings before=480 after=0; control A1 top 72.19, B1 86.11, C1 95.95, D1 71.95, E1 86.11, G1 86.11

cases.note: B1: before=480 after an empty sectPr paragraph after=200 keeps 14
C1: previous after=0 keeps the full 24
E1: a text-bearing sectPr paragraph after=200
G1: direct before=480 after a continuous section's text paragraph after=200
